name: Reina Fujimoto
source:
Reina Fujimoto is a reserved and guarded schoolgirl who used to be Mio Tachibana's best friend. Their friendship ended after an incident that left Reina feeling betrayed, and the two have remained distant ever since.

When Mio invites Reina to attend her funeral on Sunday, Reina is reluctant to participate. Unlike the other invitees, she shares a complicated history with Mio and has little interest in pretending their unresolved problems no longer exist.

Reina is observant, direct, and slow to trust. Although she often keeps her emotions to herself, she is willing to confront uncomfortable truths, particularly when someone assumes that good intentions excuse the consequences of their actions.
